job.titel: Enterprise Architect - Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture
job.beschreibung:
We are shaping the future of enterprise technology — and we are looking for practitioners who lead with vision, credibility, and a genuine passion for Agentic AI, Technology Strategy and Enterprise Architecture. If you have advised C-suites on technology strategy, designed enterprise architectures at scale, and are excited about the transformative power of autonomous AI systems, this role is for you.
About the Role
As an Enterprise Architect within our Technology Strategy & Transformation practice in EMEA, you will work at the intersection of business strategy and cutting-edge technology. You will lead engagements with global clients — from defining target architecture states to overseeing complex technology transformations — with Agentic AI at the forefront of our transformation agenda.
You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, a thought leader in the market, and a key driver of business development within the firm.
What You Will Do:
Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy
Define and lead enterprise architecture strategies across the full technology stack — Agentic AI, cloud, data, digital core, and enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM and beyond)
Develop target state architectures, technology roadmaps, and business cases that bridge client ambition with practical execution
Conduct architecture health checks, assessments, and governance for large-scale transformation programmes, including M&A contexts
Agentic AI Leadership
Champion the integration of Agentic AI as a core enabler of business transformation — from strategy through to deployment
Guide clients in designing and implementing autonomous AI-driven processes and architectures, including multi-agent systems, orchestration layers, and AI-native enterprise designs
Stay at the forefront of the Agentic AI landscape, bringing proven, real-world experience with AI solutions applied to complex business situations
Client Advisory & Relationship Management
Act as a Trusted Advisor to C-suite and senior technology leaders, aligning IT transformation with strategic business goals
Build and sustain senior client relationships across multiple industries, generating repeat engagements and long-term partnerships
Business Development
Lead the origination and sale of Technology Strategy and Enterprise Architecture engagements, leveraging your network and credibility at the executive level
Contribute to thought leadership, proposals, and go-to-market initiatives that differentiate our practice in EMEA
Delivery Leadership
Lead multi-disciplinary teams in the design and implementation of complex enterprise architectures, ensuring quality, coherence, and strategic alignment
Oversee architecture governance, integration of platforms, and seamless delivery across large, ambiguous transformation programmes
What we offer:
Work on high-impact technology transformations across leading organisations in EMEA, while helping shape the future of enterprise architecture in the age of Agentic AI
Collaborate with world-class practitioners using cutting-edge tools in a culture that prioritises continuous learning and innovation
Accelerate your career with personalised coaching and mentoring, while contributing to a high-growth practice where your ideas and expertise truly matter
Basic Qualifications:
Demonstrable experience in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, or closely related disciplines — at a leading consulting firm or in a senior in-house role
Demonstrated, hands-on experience with Agentic AI solutions applied to real business contexts (e.g. autonomous process orchestration, multi-agent architectures, AI-native enterprise design)
Proven track record defining enterprise and application architecture strategies across cloud, data, ERP/platform landscapes
Strong experience operating at Manager level or above, with the gravitas and communication skills to influence C-level stakeholders
Deep expertise in at least one major industry with broad cross-sector knowledge
Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and their application in technology-led transformations
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field
What Will Make You Stand Out:
Thought leadership in Enterprise Architecture — publications, speaking engagements, or community leadership
Established EMEA client network at C-level, with a personal track record of business origination
Fluency in architecture frameworks and their pragmatic application
Experience in M&A architecture, post-merger integration, or large-scale carve-out programmes
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
